body.intent: Fix rhiza change show failing with 'canon: not canonical' on a change set whose op has a text field holding an @-reference together with <, > or &: model.ShowFieldValue (internal/model/textshow.go) re-encodes the shown text with json.Marshal, which HTML-escapes those characters, so op.Encode's canonical check rejects it. Seen on change set 01M6VY7G (Workflow dispatch), whose arbiter Decision workflow-dispatch-shape has '@{...}' and '->' in its statement. Encode the shown text canonically (e.g. canon.Marshal or an encoder with SetEscapeHTML(false)), with a test of a field holding an @-reference and '->'
body.title: Fix change show HTML escape
